lesson: MRS threshold tightening (15/30 → 12/25) on regime_engine_daily v2.0 worsened MDD from 34.3% to 36.0% while reducing CAGR by 0.49pp. Tighter MRS triggers de-risking in volatile-but-not-crisis periods, causing whipsaw drag without drawdown benefit. This confirms L-465~470: overlay parameter optimization must be crisis-regime-specific, not simple threshold adjustment. The underlying regime engine (9-axis FRED daily + t-1 lag) is PIT-clean per Hamilton(1989) MRS framework adapted to daily granularity. Value+ESBR synergy alpha is genuine but modest (SR 0.848); insufficient standalone but potential diversifier in multi-sleeve portfolio.
